The bracket is the Riemann sum \(\sum_{k=1}^{n} f(k/n)\):
\[\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{2}{n}\sum_{k=1}^{n} f\!\left(\frac{k}{n}\right)=2\int_0^1 \log_2\!\left(1+\tan\tfrac{\pi x}{4}\right)dx = 2I.\]
Apply \(x\to 1-x\): \(\tan\frac{\pi(1-x)}{4}=\frac{1-t}{1+t}\) with \(t=\tan\frac{\pi x}{4}\), so

Adding the two forms of \(I\): \(2I=\int_0^1 1\,dx=1\Rightarrow I=\tfrac12\).
